notes: Water at the 200 mL line; scale 100–300 mL.

title: Measuring jug with water
notes: Plastic kitchen jug with handle and spout; scale every 50 mL, numbered 250, 500, 750, 1000; water at the 500 mL line.

notes: Scale 0–100 mL, ticks every 2 mL, numbers every 10 (10–100); water with a concave meniscus whose bottom sits on the 60 mL line.

notes: Clock shows 3:00: short hour hand on 3, long minute hand on 12, no second hand; numbers 1–12 and minute ticks.

title: Kitchen scale
notes: Dial scale with an empty pan; dial 0–1000 g (0 at the top), ticks every 20 g, numbers every 100 g; pointer on 0.

title: Pan balance
notes: Classroom bucket balance, empty and level; pointer on the center mark.

title: Centimeter ruler
notes: 15 cm ruler seen from above: mm ticks, longer half-cm ticks, cm numbers 0–15. Wide canvas (1200×350).

title: Protractor
notes: Half-circle protractor, ticks every 1°, 5° and 10°; outer scale 0–180 from the left, inner (blue) scale 0–180 from the right; center hole on the baseline. Wide canvas (1200×720).
